title: The Lamplighter
text: A lamplighter in the Faceless City goes from post to post with his long pole, lighting lamps that burn a cold green. Under them, every passer-by shows their true face, just for a heartbeat. Some of them scream when they see it.

options.label: Each Scion walks under the green lamps to see their own true face.

outcomes.text: They see their own face, a little older and a little sadder.
It is not their face. They do not say whose it was.

options.label: Each Scion keeps to the dark between the lamps, unwilling to see the truth.

outcomes.text: The faces waiting in the dark are worse, and closer.
